claims.claim: Elections B.C. recorded 891,348 advance votes from October 16 to 21, about 24 per cent of registered voters, compared with 1,001,331 and about 28 per cent in 2024.

claims.supporting_quote: Over six days of advance voting from Oct. 16 to 21, 891,348 voters turned out across B.C., representing about 24 per cent of registered voters. That's compared with 1,001,331 voters in 2024, or about 28 per cent of registered voters.
